title: Design System: PunchMe
note: Before the redesign. Read from the code at the redesign-start tag; Phase 1 of docs/redesign/guide.md replaces it, and this file with it.

display.purpose: `.t-h1`. The landing hero. Hebrew: tracking 0, line height 1.12.

headline.purpose: `.t-h2`. Section openers. Hebrew: tracking 0, line height 1.18.

title-card.purpose: `.t-card-title`. Panel, studio panel and disclosure titles.

stat.purpose: `.t-stat`. The landing's sourced figures, printed and never counted up.

lead.purpose: `.t-lead`. The paragraph under a section opener. Hebrew line height 1.7.

control.purpose: Labels, legends, toggles, chips and quiet buttons.

island.purpose: The wallet switch inside the phone's island.

tag.purpose: The dashboard Tag. Uppercase. Plex Mono has no Hebrew.

readout-label.purpose: The label under a readout's rule. Uppercase.

shadows.name: panel
shadows.purpose: Every panel at rest, always with a hairline. Same value as `card`.

shadows.name: panel-night
shadows.purpose: `panel` at night: real black, cast further.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: Hover, popovers, the brief band and the lit stage. Same value as `lift`.

shadows.name: seated-edge
shadows.purpose: Under the primary CTA; 0 1px 0 0 when pressed.

shadows.name: cta-glow
shadows.purpose: The gradient CTA at rest; 0 10px 28px -8px at 0.85 on hover.

shadows.name: cta-glow-warm
shadows.purpose: The warm pricing CTA at rest.

shadows.name: progress-halo
shadows.purpose: The wizard's progress capsule; spread only, so nothing reflows.

shadows.name: ui-card
shadows.purpose: The old `ui` Card, hard-coded. Deepens to 0 16px 36px at 0.12 on hover.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Words rise: a long settle, no overshoot. fade-up 0.7s, draw-rule 0.55s, scale-in 0.8s, sheet-up 0.22s, pop-in 0.16s.

motion.name: land
motion.purpose: Objects land: overshoot and settle, like a rubber stamp. stamp-in 0.34s, pill-travel 0.34s, the progress pill's 300ms travel.

motion.name: fade-in
motion.purpose: The brief band and the activity chart appearing.

motion.name: float
motion.purpose: A 10px bob in the landing hero.

motion.name: bloom-drift
motion.purpose: The hero's light breathing, slow enough to read as atmosphere.

motion.name: scan-sweep
motion.purpose: The scanner's moving line: status, not decoration.

motion.name: hover-transition
motion.purpose: The old Button, a resting card's lift (cardHover), chevrons.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Today every keyframe utility is switched off under prefers-reduced-motion; transitions opt out per call site. The redesign rule is gentler, not none.

components.name: Primary CTA
components.description: ctaClasses('primary'): the one button of the wizard, sign-in and the dashboard. Seated on a 2px edge; navy on gold in oat, white on indigo by day, white on night violet at night.
components.html: <button class="ds-cta-primary">Next <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="m12 5 7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>

components.name: Secondary CTA

components.name: Old pill button
components.description: components/ui Button: hard-coded navy pill with a gold halo on hover. No focus style of its own, so the browser's outline shows. Admin and /style-guide only; Phase 10 deletes it.

components.name: Field
components.description: fieldClasses / the studio's controlClasses: a well in the ground colour on a panel, a hairline that firms on hover, and the focus ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; max-width: 320px; font-family: Assistant, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font: 500 14px/20px Assistant, system-ui, sans-serif; color: rgb(var(--c-ink, 17 17 17)); } .ds-field-hint { font: 400 12px/16px Assistant, system-ui, sans-serif; color: rgb(var(--c-ink-subtle, 85 85 95)); } .ds-field-input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-border, 226 227 246)); border-radius: 12px; background: rgb(var(--c-background, 245 246 254)); color: rgb(var(--c-ink, 17 17 17)); font: 400 16px/24px Assistant, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: rgb(var(--c-ink-subtle, 85 85 95)); } .ds-field-input:hover { border-color: rgb(var(--c-border-strong, 202 204 238)); } .ds-field-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgb(var(--c-primary, 91 65 230)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(var(--c-background, 245 246 254)), 0 0 0 4px rgb(var(--c-primary-text, 104 61 232)); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: Panel with PanelHeader: a hairline, the panel ground and a shallow shadow; the title, a hint, and the one action at the end of the row.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-panel { max-width: 420px; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-border, 226 227 246)); border-radius: 16px; background: rgb(var(--c-surface, 255 255 255)); box-shadow: var(--shadow-panel, 0 1px 2px rgb(14 17 32 / 0.04), 0 1px 3px rgb(14 17 32 / 0.06)); } .ds-panel-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0; font: 700 19px/1.3 Rubik, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: rgb(var(--c-ink, 17 17 17)); } .ds-panel-title:dir(rtl) { letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-panel-hint { margin: 4px 0 0; font: 400 14px/20px Assistant, system-ui, sans-serif; color: rgb(var(--c-ink-muted, 65 65 65)); } .ds-panel-action { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-border-strong, 202 204 238)); border-radius: 8px; background: rgb(var(--c-surface, 255 255 255)); color: rgb(var(--c-ink, 17 17 17)); font: 700 14px/20px Assistant, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-panel-action:hover { border-color: rgb(var(--c-ink-subtle, 85 85 95)); } .ds-panel-action:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(var(--c-background, 245 246 254)), 0 0 0 4px rgb(var(--c-primary-text, 104 61 232)); }

components.name: Tags
components.description: Tag: a state in one word, in mono. Every tone is a 15% wash of itself except reward, the one filled tag (navy on gold, 10.06:1). The ok tone fails AA by day (4.43:1).
components.html: Draft Pro Saved Void Failed Reward ready
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; white-space: nowrap; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; font: 400 11px/1.5 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-tag-neutral { background: rgb(var(--c-ink, 17 17 17) / 0.07); color: rgb(var(--c-ink-muted, 65 65 65)); } .ds-tag-accent { background: rgb(var(--c-primary-text, 104 61 232) / 0.15); color: rgb(var(--c-primary-text, 104 61 232)); } .ds-tag-ok { background: rgb(var(--c-ok, 4 120 87) / 0.15); color: rgb(var(--c-ok, 4 120 87)); } .ds-tag-warn { background: rgb(var(--c-warn, 146 64 14) / 0.15); color: rgb(var(--c-warn, 146 64 14)); } .ds-tag-danger { background: rgb(var(--c-danger, 185 28 28) / 0.15); color: rgb(var(--c-danger, 185 28 28)); } .ds-tag-reward { background: #f0b429; color: #0e1120; }

components.name: Notice
components.description: Notice: something said out loud, on the state's own fill with a lucide icon. warn carries most of the traffic and is deliberately calm.
components.html: This card is waiting on activation.
components.css: .ds-notice { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; max-width: 420px; margin: 0; padding: 12px 16px; border-radius: 12px; background: rgb(var(--c-warn-bg, 255 251 235)); color: rgb(var(--c-warn, 146 64 14)); font: 400 14px/20px Assistant, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-notice svg { flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Toggle
components.description: Toggle: a real role=switch in a 44px row; the label is part of the control and the knob slides toward the end edge in either direction.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; font: 500 14px/20px Assistant, system-ui, sans-serif; color: rgb(var(--c-ink, 17 17 17)); } .ds-toggle-input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; } .ds-toggle-track { position: relative; flex-shrink: 0; width: 44px; height: 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(var(--c-ink, 17 17 17) / 0.2); transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-toggle-knob { position: absolute; top: 2px; inset-inline-start: 2px; width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.06); transition: transform 150ms; } .ds-toggle-input:checked + .ds-toggle-track { background: rgb(var(--c-primary, 91 65 230)); } .ds-toggle-input:checked + .ds-toggle-track .ds-toggle-knob { transform: translateX(20px); } .ds-toggle-input:checked + .ds-toggle-track .ds-toggle-knob:dir(rtl) { transform: translateX(-20px); } .ds-toggle-input:focus-visible + .ds-toggle-track { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(var(--c-background, 245 246 254)), 0 0 0 4px rgb(var(--c-primary-text, 104 61 232)); }

components.name: Filter chips
components.description: FilterChips: 44px pills that show their count; active takes the accent fill, and an empty bucket is disabled unless it is the active one, so a search can never trap you in it.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; } .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(var(--c-border, 226 227 246)); border-radius: 9999px; background: rgb(var(--c-surface, 255 255 255)); color: rgb(var(--c-ink-muted, 65 65 65)); font: 500 14px/20px Assistant, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms, border-color 150ms, background-color 150ms; } .ds-chip:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: rgb(var(--c-border-strong, 202 204 238)); color: rgb(var(--c-ink, 17 17 17)); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: rgb(var(--c-primary, 91 65 230)); background: rgb(var(--c-primary, 91 65 230)); color: rgb(var(--c-primary-on, 255 255 255)); } .ds-chip:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgb(var(--c-background, 245 246 254)), 0 0 0 4px rgb(var(--c-primary-text, 104 61 232)); } .ds-chip-count { font: 500 12px/16px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: rgb(var(--c-ink-subtle, 85 85 95)); } .ds-chip[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-chip-count { color: rgb(var(--c-primary-on, 255 255 255)); }

narrative.overview:
The strongest idea in today's system is not a colour, and it lives in the comments rather than in any token. A page is paper or a room, and the things the product is about are objects set down on it. Words rise into place on a long settle, and objects land with the overshoot of a rubber stamp. At night the room goes dark and what the owner reads goes dark with it. What the owner hands to someone else keeps its own light. A QR code is staged under a lamp rather than repainted, and a printed standee keeps the owner's colours down to the last hairline while the desk under it turns. The pass is the exception that proves the rule. It is a screen, not paper, so it turns with the room, and only its colours are a spec match, because they are the owner's.

The surface around that idea is layered. One set of token names covers the ground, the panel, three inks, the accent, two borders and four states. It is painted in four scopes: the original oat card stock with a gold accent, the landing page's violet on white, a raised variant for the single-panel pages, and night for the dashboard. Underneath sits an older set, `components/ui`, which paints navy on white directly and ignores all four. The two disagree about corners, focus rings and what the accent is.

Public pages are spacious, banded and bright. The dashboard is quieter: hairline panels on a shallow shadow, one loud surface at most, and state said in a word and a small mono tag, never in colour alone. Every colour that carries text has its ratio written beside it. The violet is under review. The design skills installed for the redesign treat purple-blue gradients as a common sign of AI-made design (guide D4), so Phase 1 keeps violet as one of three candidates, not as a given.
keyCharacteristics: One token vocabulary, four scopes, switched by a class (on `<html>` for the dashboard and its night mode).
A measured contrast ratio beside every text colour, quoted against the tighter of its grounds.
Two motion curves with meanings: words rise, objects land.
Corners just taken off (8, 12 and 16px), and pills only for states and switches.
A hairline plus a shallow shadow, in two levels, cast in real black at night.
Rubik 700 for display, Assistant for reading, Plex Mono for figures and labels. Hebrew is set in the same families as the Latin.
The wallet pass previews are staged in a 300px slot and never redrawn.

rules.name: The Fill-and-Its-Ink Rule
rules.body: A fill never assumes the colour of its own label. Whatever sits on `primary` uses `primary.on`, and accent-coloured text uses `primary.text`, measured per scope. `primary` itself is never text on a light ground.

rules.name: The Measured Rule
rules.body: Every colour that carries text has its ratio written beside it, against every ground it can sit on, and the tighter one is quoted. Nothing on a gradient is set in white-with-an-alpha, because alpha composites differently at each end and cannot be measured once.

rules.name: The Reward-Is-Gold Rule
rules.body: Gold means the thing being collected towards and is never a state. As a fill it carries navy; as text it is `reward`.

rules.name: The Hebrew-First Rule
rules.body: Type is judged in Hebrew. Tracking that makes Latin read as signage smears Hebrew, so every display class drops it and opens its leading under `[dir="rtl"]`.

rules.name: The Mono-Is-for-Digits Rule
rules.body: Plex Mono has no Hebrew. It sets figures, pass field labels and tags, isolated left to right, and never running text. Roboto has none either and appears only in the Google Wallet preview.

rules.name: The Thumb Floor Rule
rules.body: 44px is the target even when the mark is 6px. Keep the box and shrink the drawing.

rules.name: The Two Levels Rule
rules.body: A surface is at rest or lifted, and nothing sits in between. At rest the hairline does most of the work.

rules.name: The Lamp Rule
rules.body: At night, what the owner reads turns dark and what the owner hands to someone keeps its own light. A QR code sits inside `theme-lit` on a lit stage, staged rather than repainted. A printed sheet keeps the owner's colours, and `rim` gives it an edge on either ground. The pass is a screen, so it turns with the page.

rules.name: The Corner-Off Rule
rules.body: Controls and containers are rectangles with the corner just taken off, at 8, 12 or 16px. The pill is reserved for states and switches.

rules.name: The One Loud Surface Rule
rules.body: The brief band is the only saturated surface in the dashboard, and only the Overview's brief and the Messages page stand on it. A second loud thing is no loud thing.

rules.name: The Two Curves Rule
rules.body: Words rise on (0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). Objects land on (0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1). An element's curve says which of the two it is.

dos: **Do** measure every text colour against every ground it can sit on, and write the ratio beside it, quoting the tighter one. All text meets AA. (Carries over.)
**Do** use logical properties only (`ms-` `me-` `ps-` `pe-` `start-` `end-` `text-start` `text-end`), and give anything that cannot be logical an `rtl:` sign flip. (Carries over.)
**Do** keep 44px targets everywhere a thumb goes, even under a 6px mark. (Carries over.)
**Do** put `focusRing` on every control: 2px `primary.text`, offset 2px in the ground colour. (Carries over.)
**Do** set running text in a face that has Hebrew, and keep Plex Mono to digits, pass field labels and tags, isolated left to right. (Carries over.)
**Do** stage `AppleCardPreview`, `GoogleCardPreview`, `StampGrid` and `PassBarcode` in their 300px slot. Frame and animate them; never redraw them. (Carries over.)
**Do** give every fill its own text token: `primary.on` on `primary`, and `primary.text` for accent-coloured text.
**Do** let what the owner hands to someone keep its own light at night: a QR code inside `theme-lit`, and a printed sheet in the owner's colours with a `rim` edge.
**Do** say a state in words and a small mono `Tag`, with colour as the second signal, never the only one.
**Do** spend the two curves for what they mean: words rise on (0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), objects land on (0.34, 1.4, 0.64, 1).
donts: **Don't** set text in gold #f0b429 (1.86:1 on white) or in Deep Gold #c88a11 (2.96:1). Gold is a fill that carries navy.
**Don't** put alpha text on a gradient. It composites differently at each end and cannot be measured once.
**Don't** reach for hand-picked Tailwind pairs like `bg-amber-50 text-amber-800` for a state. They vanish on the night ground; `ok`, `warn`, `danger` and `reward` don't.
**Don't** add a second loud surface to the dashboard. The brief band is on the Overview and Messages, and nowhere else.
**Don't** spend `rim` at /12. It compiles to nothing; spend it at /10.
**Don't** build on `components/ui`. It is hard-coded navy, ignores the night theme, has no focus style on its Button, and holds three of the four known AA failures. Phase 10 deletes it.
**Don't** treat today's violet, its gradients or the oat and gold palette as settled. Phase 1 chooses the brand colour, with violet as one of three candidates (guide D4).
**Don't** take today's reduced-motion handling as the standard. It switches every keyframe off; the rule is gentler, not none. (Carries over as a rule; today's code does not meet it.)
